summary_en: 400,000 shares (5.21% of shares outstanding) to be acquired on 2026-06-16 via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥470/share (closing price on 2026-06-15), total ¥188.0M. Execution during morning session (08:45 JST), single-tranche offering. Order valid for that trading session only; partial or no execution possible depending on market conditions.
title_en: Notice of acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-auction trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-06-15, Medix Inc.'s board of directors authorized the acquisition of 400,000 treasury shares (5.2% of shares outstanding) via off-auction trading (ToSTNeT-3) on 2026-06-16. The purchase will occur during the morning session at 08:45 JST at ¥470 per share (the closing price on 2026-06-15), for a total of ¥188.0M. The order is valid only for that single trading session; partial or complete non-execution is possible depending on market conditions and order matching. The stated rationale is to enable flexible capital allocation in response to changes in the operating environment. The reference note shows 7,667,500 shares outstanding (excluding treasury) as of 2026-03-31, and 412,500 shares held in treasury at that date.
